treatment_recommendations: Continue current deep watering schedule twice weekly.

Feed with a balanced organic liquid fertilizer rich in trace minerals.

recommendations.recommendation: Prune lower blight-affected leaves & apply copper bio-fungicide
recommendations.explanation: Removing lower leaves with concentric lesions stops Alternaria spores from splashing onto healthy upper foliage.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Remove the bottom 3–4 infected leaflets with clean shears and mist canopy with organic copper soap.

recommendations.recommendation: Rotate container 90° and mist aerial roots
recommendations.explanation: Even light exposure ensures balanced petiole posture and larger fenestrations on new leaves.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Turn pot a quarter turn clockwise and wipe dust from broad leaf surfaces with a damp cloth.

recommendations.recommendation: Supplement with magnesium & balanced organic nitrogen
recommendations.explanation: Corrects interveinal chlorosis and supports healthy flower and fruit set.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Water with 500ml of chelated micronutrient solution during morning irrigation.

recommendations.recommendation: Deep base watering & organic mulch refresh
recommendations.explanation: Keeps root zone cool and moist without wetting foliage.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Deliver 3 liters of water at the root collar and maintain a 5cm bark mulch layer.

recommendations.recommendation: Wipe broad leaf lamina & check top 2 inches of soil
recommendations.explanation: Dust-free violin-shaped leaves absorb up to 30% more indirect indoor sunlight.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Gently wipe upper and lower leaf surfaces with a soft damp microfiber cloth.

recommendations.recommendation: Maintain gentle humidity around emerging white spathes
recommendations.explanation: Consistent 55–65% relative humidity prevents brown leaf tips and prolongs bloom life.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Mist surrounding air with filtered water and keep soil lightly moist.
